title: Deep Search with Hierarchical Meta-Cognitive Monitoring Inspired by Cognitive Neuroscience
authors: Zhongxiang Sun; Qipeng Wang; Weijie Yu; Jingxuan Yang; Haolang Lu; Jun Xu
why_relevant: Proposes a metacognitive monitoring framework for deep search agents that detects abnormal reasoning/retrieval states using consistency between searching entropy and reasoning entropy, and triggers corrective intervention—directly addressing calibration, control, and when-to-intervene under uncertainty in RAG-like agents.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on deep search agents rather than canonical RAG; robustness framing is broad rather than specifically targeting noise/conflict/adversarial settings.
